Container.Name: cognee
Container.Overview:
Cognee graph memory (official cognee/cognee 1.6.5 with a thin Unraid layer) for the OpenJarvis container. Builds a knowledge graph over the markdown vault, which it mounts read-only. Embeddings run locally on CPU (fastembed, bge-small-en-v1.5); entity extraction uses Anthropic or Mistral (whichever key you set), so ingesting notes sends their text to that provider.
No host port by default: OpenJarvis reaches it as http://cognee:8000 on jarvis-net. The API requires COGNEE_API_KEY (blank: generated once and printed in the log). Install this before OpenJarvis. First ingestion is manual: docker exec cognee cognee-ingest --estimate, then docker exec cognee cognee-ingest.
Container.Requires: Network jarvis-net (docker network create jarvis-net) and Docker setting "Preserve user defined networks: Yes".

Config.Name: Cognee data (cache pool)
Config.Description: All Cognee stores (SQLite, LanceDB, graph), its API key, the ingest state and the embedding model cache.

Config.Name: Vault (read only)
Config.Description: The same markdown share as OpenJarvis, mounted read-only. Cognee never writes to it.

Config.Name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Config.Description: Anthropic key for entity extraction during ingestion (cognify). Set this or MISTRAL_API_KEY. Recall does not use the LLM.

Config.Name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
Config.Description: Mistral key, used for ingestion when no Anthropic key is set (or when COGNEE_LLM_PROVIDER is mistral).

Config.Name: COGNEE_LLM_MODEL
Config.Description: Model for ingestion. Blank: claude-sonnet-5-5 (Anthropic) or mistral-medium-latest (Mistral). Cheaper: claude-haiku-5-5 or mistral-small-latest.

Config.Name: COGNEE_LLM_PROVIDER
Config.Description: anthropic or mistral. Blank: Anthropic if its key is set, else Mistral.

Config.Name: COGNEE_API_KEY
Config.Description: API key clients send as X-Api-Key. Set the same value in OpenJarvis. Blank: generated once, stored in /cognee-data/.api_key and printed in the log.

Config.Name: COGNEE_EXCLUDE
Config.Description: Extra vault folders never sent to Cognee, comma separated (names or paths, for example inbox,daily/private). _backups, personas and hidden folders are always skipped.

Config.Name: Host port (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Publishes the Cognee API on the LAN, for example to open the graph view. Leave blank to keep it private to jarvis-net.
